name: @royco/access-subgraph
description: Goldsky subgraph indexing Royco's OZ AccessManager + Concrete vault AccessControl

scripts.prepare:mainnet: npm run render:mainnet && npm run codegen && npm run build
scripts.deploy:mainnet: NO_GRAFT=1 npm run render:mainnet && npm run codegen && npm run build && goldsky subgraph deploy royco-access-mainnet/0.2.0 --path .
scripts.deploy:avalanche: NO_GRAFT=1 npm run render:avalanche && npm run codegen && npm run build && goldsky subgraph deploy royco-access-avalanche/0.2.0 --path .
scripts.deploy:arbitrum: NO_GRAFT=1 npm run render:arbitrum && npm run codegen && npm run build && goldsky subgraph deploy royco-access-arbitrum/0.2.0 --path .
scripts.deploy:base: NO_GRAFT=1 npm run render:base && npm run codegen && npm run build && goldsky subgraph deploy royco-access-base/0.2.0 --path .
scripts.create-local: graph create --node http://localhost:8020 royco-access-mainnet && graph create --node http://localhost:8020 royco-access-avalanche && graph create --node http://localhost:8020 royco-access-arbitrum && graph create --node http://localhost:8020 royco-access-base
scripts.deploy-local:mainnet: npm run render:mainnet && npm run codegen && graph deploy --node http://localhost:8020 --ipfs http://localhost:5001 --version-label local royco-access-mainnet
scripts.deploy-local:avalanche: npm run render:avalanche && npm run codegen && graph deploy --node http://localhost:8020 --ipfs http://localhost:5001 --version-label local royco-access-avalanche
scripts.deploy-local:arbitrum: npm run render:arbitrum && npm run codegen && graph deploy --node http://localhost:8020 --ipfs http://localhost:5001 --version-label local royco-access-arbitrum
scripts.deploy-local:base: npm run render:base && npm run codegen && graph deploy --node http://localhost:8020 --ipfs http://localhost:5001 --version-label local royco-access-base
